snippet.title: About The Game 🌸 Magical Warrior Diamond Heart Intro Video
snippet.description:
I made this video for tiktok to introduce the game to my new followers, I also wanted to post it here as well. I'll make videos explaining the cast later on haha!

Magical Warrior Diamond Heart is a female-centered romance game about magical girls! Play as Valerie Amaranth, a sixteen year old black girl who becomes the leader of a team of magical warriors after she gains the ability to transform into the legendary Crystal Warrior, Diamond Heart! 

Will Val defeat the Nightmares, make new friends, and find love along the way? Or will she meet a tragic end? 

If you're interested:

🌸Official Website 🌸
http://magicalwarriordiamondheart.com

🎮 Play the Demo 🎮
https://pyonkotchi.itch.io/magicalwarriordiamondheart

💸 Support the Development 💸
https://www.patreon.com/Pyonkotchi
